vpn.profileDesc: Reach this host through a VPN the Termix server is not otherwise on. Termix raises the tunnel; the host goes in through it.
vpn.managerHint: Termix raises each VPN itself and keeps it in a network of its own, so two with overlapping addresses do not collide. The credentials are stored encrypted.
vpn.name: Name
vpn.passwordUnchanged: Leave blank to keep the stored password
vpn.saveFailed: Could not save the network profile
vpn.deleteFailed: Could not delete the network profile
vpn.overridesProxy: This host has both a network and its own proxy. The network is used; the proxy settings below are ignored.
vpn.kindLocked: This cannot be changed after a profile is made.
vpn.authKeyNote: Must be reusable: a new node registers each time the tunnel comes up.
vpn.setupKeyNote: Use a reusable key, so the peer can register again if the manager is rebuilt.
vpn.trustedFingerprintHint: The gateway's public key digest. Leave empty unless its certificate is not publicly trusted.
vpn.managedHint: Termix raises this tunnel itself through the VPN manager. The credentials are stored encrypted.
vpn.noManager: No VPN manager is configured, so Termix cannot raise a tunnel itself.
vpn.switchFailed: Could not enable or disable the VPN
vpn.kindDeclaredLegacy: This VPN's tunnel is run outside Termix. New ones are raised by Termix; this one is kept as it is.
vpn.disconnectFailed: Could not take the VPN down

gateway.title: Reach hosts through a VPN
gateway.description: Lets a session leave through the network its host is assigned to.
